3640 GREEN SIGNAL IS THE PRIORITY — build it next, ahead of everything but the fix set itself
Alex is the notification today and that ends: green holds 3h → one mail, regression → one mail, otherwise silence.
RED ZERO_CLAIM: claimed=0, queued=435, 4 passes, max_concurrent=20 (3597 hysteresis ×3)

TASK 1 CORRECTION — door-stop REVERTED (sha b06e6486, ver 18c64157). Blocking tok…0A6XBN + ip 2a06:98c0:3600::103 dropped claimed 6→0. That identity is the LIVE mastra executor (tick alive, tick_n 7628), not a separable zombie. The "phantom" is the same flaky process claiming-then-stalling — it cannot be denied by identity without killing all throughput. So the 120s no-progress release is the correct tool after all: it frees a stalled claim so the SAME executor retries. The real bug is the STALL — lease-expiry/executor-not-finishing (auto-HOLDs on 1843/1839). Watching claimed recover after DO cycles. Not a stop vs mop problem; an executor-finish problem.
